<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement regarding claims handlers struggling with outdated or unclear processes affecting task tracking and document handling. The most similar completed story, \"Bulk upload documents to a claim\" (4127), only addresses a narrow part of document handling, while the \"Task overview\" roadmap page covers task tracking. However, neither item fully solves the overarching problem of outdated or unclear processes causing delays and reduced productivity. Therefore, the core problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
